rules.name: Medical Assistance - Karmika Arogya Bhagya (Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board)

rules.message: Registered construction worker with the Karnataka BOCW Welfare Board, or a dependant of one
Hospitalised for at least 48 hours continuously in a Government hospital, a Schedule I private hospital, or a hospital recognised under a State Government insurance scheme

benefits.text: ₹300 per day of hospitalisation, up to a maximum of ₹20,000, subject to actual costs.

required_documents.name: Proof of identity / Board smart card (attested)
Hospital bills showing admission and discharge dates and all treatment given

how_to_apply.text: Apply within 6 months of the start of hospitalisation, through the Board's (KB&OWWB) software.
The application is verified by a Senior/Labour Inspector and approved by the Labour Officer.

evidence.claim: Who: registered worker and dependants; which hospitals
evidence.quote: may sanction financial assistance to a registered construction worker and their dependents hospitalised in a Government hospital or a private hospital included in Schedule I
The assistance shall be towards hospitalisation for minimum 48 Hours continuously.
The financial assistance shall be Rs 300/- per day of the hospitalisation to the maximum of Rs 20,000/-
or a hospital recognised under any insurance Scheme of the State Government.
Bills of hospital showing admission and discharge dates and all treatment given
Form XXII-A • Application can be submitted within 6 months of hospitalisation commencement date • Applicants submit the application through KB&OWWB software
Application processing and Verification by Senior/ Labour Inspector. 3. Review and Approval by Labour Officer

notes: Board registration and hospital stay cannot be answered by the questionnaire, so both are manual checks.
